title: canonical imu model gcsv and mcraw

commit.merge_subject: merge: canonical imu model gcsv and mcraw

description:
what: replace the gcsv-only GyroSample model with a canonical ImuData
type (dual-stream: gyro rad/s + accel m/s^2 incl. gravity, per-sample
ns timestamps, raw orientation/timestampSource/sensorOrientation keys)
and two loaders: parseGcsv (path + istream) and parseImuFromMcraw, a new
embedded-imu loader built on the vendored motioncam-decoder's
hasGyroData/loadGyroData and hasAccelerometerData/loadAccelerometerData
streams.

why: phase 1 of gyro stabilization needs one normalized in-memory
representation that both the sidecar .gcsv and the embedded container
feed into, so phases 2+ (orientation filter, sync, stab math) can be
written against a single well-tested model. the streams are kept
separate because the mcraw container stores gyro and accelerometer as
independent blocks with their own rates and timestamps; a merged
per-timestamp sample type would fabricate alignment the format does
changed: feat: canonical imu model with gcsv and mcraw loaders
